# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 110 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 52 | Coptic

---

## Saying 110

Jesus said: "Let the one who has found the world and become rich renounce the world."

---

**Translator's Notes (LOGOS):**

- "The one who has found" — gender-neutral
- The brevity of the saying is preserved
- "Renounce the world" — the full Coptic renunciation verb maintained
